simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_sab_titan_amstar_app_starts.py, run_dump_sab_titan_amstar_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 4-digit 7-segment display " ON " -> "    " -> "boot"), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) (6.57 MB) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and without the board's anti-clone security IC renders its blue Amstar OSD dialog ("SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW! ----00000000000000 06020200") through GeM3602 (14 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: SAB Titan I HD 3602 / Opticum HD X4-series (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.5.22 with the Amstar GUI (2012-03-18) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol, " ON " -> "boot"), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
